name: Kyle of Lochalsh
method: tidetimes.org.uk Kyle of Lochalsh vs its own Ullapool (UKHO-derived), applied to our gauge-fitted Ullapool: median time difference, least-squares height fit
note: Height = offset + scale * Ullapool. Tobermory doesn't fit (its turns are 35 min apart and drift). HW scatters ~7 min round the median. Heights follow tidetimes, Ullapool's Z0 is set to UKHO's level. Times are slack-water-ish only: Kyle Rhea's race is next door, use a stream atlas. Kayak-grade, not for navigation.
calibrated_from: tidetimes.org.uk Kyle of Lochalsh vs Ullapool, 2025-10-01 to 2026-11-19 (every 3 day(s), 527 events) via tools/calibrate-shift.ts
